correctness.rationale: In the primary full text, the resolution is a free quotient of the total space of the elliptic polarization. Equivariant line-bundle descent gives a degree-one bundle A and a primitive torsion bundle M. On W=Tot(A^-1⊕M), O(F)=π*A^-1 and K_W=π*(A⊗M^-1). The exact divisor localization sequence yields Cl(X)=Pic(B)/<A>=Pic0(B). Pullback of any Cartier class to each contracted proper fiber forces N|B=A^a at the distinguished point or q*N=L^a elsewhere; degree forces a=0 for normalized N. Thus the local kernels are 0 at zero and contained in ker(q*) elsewhere. The latter is the cyclic character group <M>, and canonical Cartierness on the nonzero axis follows from étale Gorenstein descent, yielding equality. These arguments apply to all integers m≥2, without extrapolating computations.

Their isogeny relationship exhibits non-Q-factoriality at every singular point, even when K is Cartier, and places the exact canonical-index jump inside a complete classification of all Weil classes.
